items.html: But the ReYu (216) of back to back is called a coupling that is not complete, for it is only to make her a vessel. And it follows that that ReYu is that spirit that he casts into her, which are the male Hasadim from the aspect of NRN; but the drop of Chaya does not remain in her, for it is a complete male power. Therefore the ReYu is Benjamin: Ben-Yamin (son of the right), male power. And it is called Ben-Oni, female power, for it is from the Neshama, Bina, the female.
